comparableAdapterFixture.description: Same real editor tags adapter through AgentApi and deterministic constant fingerprint adapter as baseline

realImageFixture.description: Actual 250x200 opaque RGBA PNG, 50000 one-pixel tiles, 10 current annotations, editor image port and sparse tags adapter through AgentApi. New image identity before cold run; actual rasterContentHash spy counts per-tile pixel hashes. Warm uses shared source/grid fingerprint cache.

limitations: Single local wall-clock samples, not LLM inference or token measurements. Constant fingerprint fixture isolates enumeration and call overhead and excludes SHA/pixel processing; only that fixture has a pre-change baseline. Actual-pixel fixture validates cold/warm cache behavior after change. Wire bytes use JSON string length; payload ASCII means equal UTF-8 bytes. Results and timing assertions check correctness/candidate count; elapsed time is reported without brittle thresholds.
